prompt: Create ONE unique transparent PNG illustration for this LeetCode problem using attached images as strict character and style references. Sparse flat 2D sketch: slightly irregular teal outlines, round cream heads, dot eyes, thin limbs, simple geometric bodies. Female has teal ponytail and curved forelock, peach shirt; male has short teal tuft, mustard shirt. Same duo proportions and faces across poses, with scene-appropriate accessories. Cream/peach/mustard/mint and occasional blue. One LONG SHALLOW horizontal scene about6:1; use small waist-up busts at ends with large relevant objects across width. Keep artwork in central band of tall canvas for trimming; empty space above/below/between objects must be genuine alpha transparency. NO white/gray background, checkerboard, panel, halo, glow, shadows, stray pixels, speech balloons, scenery or3D. All figures safely within margins, opaque interiors. Minimal exact text only when specified. Illustrate task premise, not solution algorithm. Strong strokes legible in light and dark UI. Scene: 3527 Find Most Common Response. Three small survey-day clipboards across one horizontal scene: first holds word tags good,good,ok; second good,bad; third good. Female with pencil inspects first clipboard, male holds a separate cream result tag good with small mint star. Each daily clipboard visually distinct by small top tab but no panel borders around scene. Only exact words specified, no frequency table or algorithm; duplicates on first day remain shown as raw input. Long shallow.
